reviews.title: Remove Skate Covers
reviews.comment: So far so good. Watch out for the protective plastic covering the skates on the bottom. They make the mouse feel like a slug if you don't know to take them off.
reviews.author: TRUMP WON

reviews.title: Does not work for me
reviews.comment: Conection issues. Will not connect to my pc on any settings and will only work plugged in some of the time. the side buttons I use for my mmo games do not work at all.
reviews.author: Jesse
